title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1966-05-19
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1966 show with an astounding Cream Puff War, killer Come Back Baby and other classic early‑Dead gems.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑sourced soundboard is praised for its crisp left‑right separation and minimal mic technique, delivering an almost pristine listening experience. The performance radiates the raw excitement of ’66, highlighted by a soaring Cream Puff War, a pig‑pen‑powered Come Back Baby, and tight renditions of Mindbender, Viola Lee Blues and Silver Threads. A few rough spots (Jerry on “Baby Blue” and Bob on “Traditional Minglewood”) don’t detract from the overall fire.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both musical performance (energy, standout songs) and recording quality (crisp soundboard), with only minor criticisms; weighted rating reflects strong show + excellent source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note crystal‑clear left/right vocal‑instrument separation, minimal mic technique that captures the band’s dynamics without clutter; no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows naturally through early‑Dead material, moving from folk‑rock numbers to bluesy jams; the energy builds and sustains throughout both halves of the concert.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Classic ‘nervous’ tone praised, though his vocal on “Baby Blue” is noted as a weak spot.
band_member_comments.Bob: His performance on traditional “Minglewood” receives criticism for being lackluster.
